## Change

Describe the bounded change and the capability it affects.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests for changed behavior pass.
- [ ] Root policy, link, inventory, generated-output, and manifest checks pass.
- [ ] Inputs and fixtures are synthetic, or their source and license are recorded.
- [ ] No employer, customer, credential, private screenshot, or production record is included.
- [ ] Claims remain within the documented project boundary.
- [ ] Generated artifacts were rebuilt in a temporary copy and compared byte-for-byte.
- [ ] UI or screenshot changes received full-size visual review.
- [ ] The change is compatible with the repository's selected root license.
